arguments.argument: set -euo pipefail; max=60; i=1; while [ "$i" -le "$max" ]; do code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' "${docker.cms.health.url}" || true); if [ "$code" = "200" ] || [ "$code" = "401" ] || [ "$code" = "403" ]; then exit 0; fi; sleep 5; i=$((i+1)); done; echo "CMS did not become ready in time"; exit 1

set -euo pipefail; max=60; i=1; while [ "$i" -le "$max" ]; do code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' "${docker.dts.health.url}" || true); if [ "$code" = "200" ] || [ "$code" = "401" ] || [ "$code" = "403" ]; then exit 0; fi; sleep 5; i=$((i+1)); done; echo "DTS did not become ready in time"; exit 1
